subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should this issue remain a separate true pause-or-abort/resume soft-steer feature, or should the remaining work be consolidated under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 as boundary-based active-run steering?
rationale: Current main implements useful boundary-steering slices, but the issue asks for a broader lifecycle that may intentionally abort or pause generation and resume with partial context, which requires maintainer product/runtime semantics before implementation.

options.title: Consolidate Boundary Steering
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 and PR 89238 or a successor for the remaining ordinary-message admission bug, then close or narrow this issue after documenting that steer remains boundary-based.

options.title: Keep True Soft-Steer Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as a separate feature and define pause, abort, partial-output capture, backend failure, and resume semantics before asking for an implementation.

options.title: Limit To Existing Modes
options.body: Declare current steer and interrupt modes sufficient for now, document the limitation, and require new evidence before reopening true mid-stream resume work.

recommendation.title: Consolidate Boundary Steering
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 and PR 89238 or a successor for the remaining ordinary-message admission bug, then close or narrow this issue after documenting that steer remains boundary-based.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this issue and closed the superseded related PR, making them the clearest available routing owner for the remaining scope decision.
